slides.title: Police ne bola 'ye hamara area nahi'?
Metro mein Bunty ka phone chori.
slides.body: Ghar aakar wo apne area ke thane pahuncha, FIR likhwane.

slides.title: Jawab mila: "Ye hamara area nahi."
slides.body: "Jahan chori hui, wahan jao." Bunty thak ke wapas mudne laga.

slides.title: Pinky: "Ruko. Zero FIR ka haq hai."
slides.body: "FIR kisi bhi thane mein likh sakte hain. Baad mein sahi thane transfer hoti hai."

slides.label: KAANOON KYA KEHTA HAI
slides.title: FIR kisi bhi thane mein.
slides.body:
BNSS 2023, Section 173:
cognizable offence ki FIR
kisi bhi police station mein
register ho sakti hai, crime
kahin bhi hua ho (Zero FIR).
Phir ye transfer hoti hai.
slides.small:
Source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, Section 173.
Ye general jaankari hai, legal advice nahi.

slides.label: TOH KYA KARO?
slides.title: Thana mana kare toh:
slides.body:
1. Politely bolo: "Zero FIR likhiye, BNSS Section 173."
2. FIR ki free copy maango.
3. Phir bhi mana? Superintendent of Police ko written complaint do.

slides.label: CHHOTA SA TIP
slides.title: e-FIR ka option bhi hai.
slides.body:
Kya hua, kab, kahan:
sab pehle se likh ke le jao.
FIR ki copy sambhal ke rakho.

slides.title: Crime kahin bhi ho, FIR yahin ho sakti hai.
slides.body:
Zero FIR.
Free copy.
Mana kare toh SP ko likho.

slides.title: Bunty wapas gaya, shaanti se bola:
slides.body: "Zero FIR likhiye, Section 173." FIR likhi gayi. Copy haath mein.

lines: Us dost ko bhejo jo 'ye hamara area nahi' sun ke laut aata hai.
Rights jo aapko pata nahi. Follow @naya.nagrik
